text:
emily: Heads up — SCIM provisioning started throwing 403s for a subset of Okta users right after the RBAC audit roll last night (04:12 UTC). KMS decrypt errors show up in the provisioner logs.

raj: Any error snippets?

emily: Log paste: 
```
[2026-04-21T04:12:39Z] scim-provisioner ERROR user=svc-12345 JWE decryption failed: authentication tag mismatch (AEADBadTagException) for ext_id 'okta|00u123'
stack: javax.crypto.AEADBadTagException: Tag mismatch
 at com.redwood.kms.JweDecryptor.decrypt(JweDecryptor.java:147)
```

maria: Did infra rotate any KMS keys / aliases recently? That AEAD error looks like a rewrap/alias mismatch.

emily: Yes — infra rotated the scim envelope key yesterday as part of the "ephemeral-key" rollout. We thought the rollout carefully rewrapped existing extids, but these are a small cohort (Okta customers created before 2024-11).

simon: Could be cached envelope headers (old alg/kid) in the provisioner or intermediate re-encryption never completed. Are audit events showing rewraps?

emily: Audit pipeline has gaps for ~30m around the rotation window — some events never landed in the audit store (we're missing rewrap confirmations). Console shows provisioner attempts succeed locally but IdP got 403.

raj: Short-term mitigation: set the provisioner to accept the legacy alias mapping temporarily. Env var: `SCIM_KMS_ALIAS_MAP=alias/redwood-scim-legacy:alias/redwood-scim-v2` and restart. That should let decrypt try both aliases.

maria: We shouldn't keep dual-alias mode indefinitely. If we expose the legacy alias mapping we must track it in the migration runbook and rotate keys after backfill.

emily: Agreed. I kicked off a dry-run of the rewrap script: `python tools/reencrypt_extid.py --dry-run --filter okta --limit 100` — it reports ~84k candidates to rewrap.

simon: We need to page oncall and create an incident. This impacts provisioning and could cause user access entropy.

maria: INC-2026-0421 opened. Paging @oncall-1. I assigned to raj + emily for hotfix.

raj: Hotfix plan: 1) temporarily enable alias map 2) run rewrap pipeline over candidates 3) validate with a fastspot check against IdP (sample 500 users) 4) remove alias map and promote new alias. Will also add a try/catch to the decrypt path to enqueue AEAD fails for rewrap instead of returning 403 to the IdP.

emily: PR for the try/catch: small change in scim-provisioner: 
```java
try {
  decrypt(extId);
} catch (AEADBadTagException e) {
  enqueueForRewrap(extId);
  throw new ProvisioningRetryableException("extid decrypt failed, enqueued for rewrap");
}
```

simon: Also: raise alert thresholds so this doesn't get lost — increase scim-decrypt-rate error budget to 0.1% and add a dedicated dashboard for AEAD failures. We should also add pre-rotation test harness to rewrap a small sample and verify end-to-end (IdP + SCIM).

maria: Action items captured in INC: backfill rewrap (job), alias-map hotfix, audit log ingestion fix, pre-rotation test harness, docs update for KMS rotation runbook.

emily: Status update 2h later: ran rewrap job in batches; rewrapped ~2.1k users first batch, sample validation passed (500/500 provisioned). After enabling alias map + queue processing, provisioning resumed for affected tenants.

raj: Resolution notes: rewrapped 84,132 extids over 12h; restarted provisioner with alias map while backfill completed; once backfill finished, removed alias map and confirmed zero AEAD errors for 24h.

maria: Postmortem checklist: 1) fix audit ingestion gap (root cause: buffered logs crashed during rotation window) 2) add pre-rotation verification step and sample rewrap 3) make rewrap idempotent and crash-resilient 4) update RBAC rollout playbook to include KMS preflight.

emily: Closing thread — follow-up tickets: ENGINFRA-721 (audit ingestion), SCIM-508 (pre-rotation test harness), KMS-319 (runbook + docs). Thanks everyone. :thumbsup:
